# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen years old (at the time of engagement) / roughly twenty-two years old (as a mother of four years married)  <sub>[v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c29 P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c18 P27](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0027)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, glossy jet-black hair, rosy cheeks, and dimples, inheriting her merry expression from her father. As she grows into adulthood, she acquires a somewhat matronly and pudgy figure, though retaining her brilliant black eyes and rosy complexion.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c17 P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010), [v2 c29 P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Diana is good, smart, unselfish, and a comfortable, faithful friend. She is practical and polite, though she can be nervous when facing scary situations or high-pressure events. While she lacks Anne's wild imagination and occasionally blights her own fancy due to her mother's strictness, she wholeheartedly admires her friend's creativity and talents.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v2 c2 P10](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0010), [v2 c6 P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v3 c12 P59](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0059)_

## History

Diana Barry grew up at Orchard Slope and formed an immediate, lifelong bond of friendship with Anne Shirley when they met as children. She attended the Avonlea school, where she participated in school events, joined the childhood Story Club, and sang a solo at the concert. Though temporarily forbidden by her mother to play with Anne after accidentally drinking currant wine, Diana was reunited with her after Anne saved her sister Minnie May from croup. Diana chose not to attend Queen's Academy because her parents did not plan to send her to college, but she remained active in local life, serving as treasurer for the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. As she grew older, she entered a romance with Fred Wright, eventually getting married at Orchard Slope. In their early years of marriage, they settled into their new home and had two children, little Fred and Small Anne Cordelia.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c16 P12](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0012), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P50](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0050), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v3 c12 P10](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0010), [v3 c29 P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Named by a boarding schoolmaster when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Raised at Orchard Slope by strict parents  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- Swore an oath of eternal friendship with Anne Shirley in the Orchard Slope garden  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)</sub>
- Engaged to Fred Wright at eighteen years old  <sub>[v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024)</sub>

> I love you devotedly, Anne, and I always will, you may be sure of that.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>

> You needn’t let what Mrs. Harmon says worry you, Married life has its ups and downs, of course. You mustn’t expect that everything will always go smoothly. But I can assure you, Anne, that it’s a happy life, when you’re married to the right man.  <sub>[v4 c1 P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006)</sub>
